resume: Scintilla is the 1981 Elka Synthex on the FM-1: its 80 factory sounds (Paul Wiffen's Laser Harp among them), compared sample by sample with the original. Two layers of 8 voices (single, split, double), poly, mono or unison, chorus and reverb; the four knobs set what the screen shows.

commandes.role: Chorus (off, 1, 2, 3), volume, unison detune, chord; again: reverb (off, plate, room, hall, galactic), size, damping, mix.
Called SCL: the joystick page, X, Y and the two BEND depths; again: recenters the joystick.
LFO 1 (speed, shape, to pitch, to cutoff), LFO 2 (speed, shape, the two joystick depths).
OSC 1, OSC 2, MIX (again: the next page).
Glide mode, amount and speed; poly, mono or unison. Again: SETTINGS (TOUCH, DEPTH, FLOOR, VELO).
Cutoff, resonance, filter envelope amount, amplitude release.
The joystick up and down: pitch bend (and the filter, depending on the BEND depths).
The 80 factory sounds: PRE 10 to 49 and MEM 10 to 49, the Synthex addresses.
The joystick left and right: LFO 2 to pitch (left) or to filter (right).
Play the two layers of 8 voices, as the patch says. The bottom two rows sense force (velocity and aftertouch, to enable in SETTINGS); the top row plays at 100.

modes.texte: KNOB 1 to 4 set the four parameters on the screen; a change applies to both layers, each from its own value. An asterisk after the address: the sound differs from the preset.

a_savoir: Sound edits are not kept (not yet); the preset, octave and page are.
USB and DIN MIDI, any channel: notes and velocity, pitch bend, CC1 the joystick to the left (vibrato), CC7 volume, CC74 cutoff, CC91 reverb, CC93 chorus, program change, pressure.
